summary: Route Mode slice 0. The profile vector was built from the candidate pool only, which excludes every paper already shown or rated, so explicit feedback and shown seeds never reached the ranking; it now uses all of the project's papers. tokenize() gains Chinese character bigrams (English output byte-identical); words() keeps the ASCII-only behaviour for everything shown to users. Equal scores break by newest date then key.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode, on top of 093562e. The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: Local deterministic ranking only; no model call, no outbound request, no budget change.
budget_impact.before: Feedback and shown seeds had no effect on ranking; Chinese text produced no tokens.
budget_impact.after: Feedback and seeds steer ranking; Chinese bigrams contribute to similarity.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

open_risks: Ranking quality on real data is unmeasured (baselines are saturated); this is a bug fix, not a demonstrated improvement.
Rankings for existing projects will change because feedback now counts and IDF is computed over all project papers.
Chinese-only projects have no interest terms on the profile page (words() is ASCII-only).
Chinese tokenization overlaps with the channels branch (same bigram approach); merging needs a manual step in app/ranking.py.
